text:
maria: Opening Azure quota + capacity request for staging cluster in eastus2. Need 6x ND40rs_v2 and 6x NCas_T4_v3 for smoke tests. Put initial numbers in the provisioning sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Xy... (owner-only).

infra-bot: Created internal ticket #INFRA-1147 and SR 210987654321 with Azure. Status: pending assignment.

raj: Thanks. Can you paste the subscription GUID and preferred reservation window? We should try to reserve capacity for Mar 29-31 for the full-stack smoke run.

maria: Sub: 8f3a2b1c-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-0a1b2c3d4e5f. Preferred window Mar 29 00:00Z - Mar 31 23:59Z. Attached an ARM snippet for the node pool config in the SR notes.

jules: Quick cost note — rough estimate for the ND40rs_v2 pool is ~$1.2k/mo for 6 GPUs on reserved capacity (dev rate). Need finance sign-off for staging burn. For NCas_T4_v3 it's much cheaper. :money_with_wings:

raj: I'll approve the staging spend. For prod we need Dedicated reservations with SLA.

az-support: Hi — I'm Anna from Azure support. I've been assigned to SR 210987654321. To expedite, please confirm subscription owner contact, desired quotas per region, and attach the deployment template. We can also initiate a capacity reservation request with our capacity team.

maria: Added owner contact (maria@redwood.ai) and uploaded ARM template and subnet plan. Network requirements: accelerated networking, GPU-enabled NICs, and a /27 subnet in the staging VNet.

jules: Heads up — /27 might be tight once autoscaling and control plane nodes land. Recommend /26. Also add NSG egress to ACR (13.107.0.0/16) and telemetry endpoints to the SR.

raj: Action list: maria -> update SR to /26, attach tags (costcenter=ai, env=staging) and contact. jules -> reach out to CSP rep for a soft-reserve escalation. I'll post approval in finance channel.

infra-bot: SR 210987654321 status updated -> Under Review by Capacity Team. Estimated hold for capacity confirmation: ~72h.

maria: Done — SR notes updated and tags added. Scheduling smoke test window Apr 2-3 in calendar; will move if capacity confirms earlier.

jules: I'll ping our CSP escalation contact and paste the thread link here when I have an update. :eyes:

raj: If capacity is tight in eastus2 we can fallback to westeurope for the staging run — let us know early so CI can flip the AZ config.

maria: Noted. SR notes include fallback region preference order: eastus2 -> westeurope -> eastus.

az-support: Update: Capacity team requested node SKU breakdown and projected sustained QPS for 2-week window. Please add that to SR or reply here.

maria: Pasted projected QPS and spike plan in the SR and included the kubernetes horizontal pod autoscaler targets.

infra-bot: SR 210987654321 comment added by Anna (Azure). Next update expected within 48-72h.

raj: Thanks all. Keep incident channel posted if capacity confirmation slips past Mar 27 so we can reschedule tests.

maria: Will do.
